page.notes: Right edge shows partial letters of the neighbouring page's text (gutter edge); not transcribed. "Anyfiam" and "Thessalonicensem" are printed with long s and read as Anysiam and Thessalonicensem; "Thessalo-" is broken at the line end as "Thessalo-/nicensem", transcribed here as the whole word. The final word "Eu." is cut at the gutter and may be "Eu-"; reading uncertain. The "cha-" below the last line is a catchword.
